title: Partial health status observability and time horizon uncertainty in mean-field game epidemiological models
summary: We introduce Mean-Field Game (MFG) epidemiological models, in which immunity either wanes with time in a fully observable way or disappears instantaneously with no direct observation (making a previously recovered individual fully susceptible again without realizing it). Both interpretations create computational challenges for rational noninfected individuals deciding on their contact rates based on their personal current immunity state and the changing epidemiological situation.
